newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy industry sees lira ERM rate as handicap-poll.
newsitem.headline: Italy industry sees lira ERM rate as handicap-poll.

text.p: More than half of Italian companies fear the lira's central Exchange Rate Mechanism parity of 990 per mark will harm exports, but they expected the lira to maintain its rate, an opinion poll published on Thursday said.
The survey, carried out by weekly news magazine Expresso, polled 72 members of the 150-company governing council of employers' confederation Confindustria.

The survey showed that 55.6 percent of respondents believed the parity rate would have a damaging effect on Italian exports. The same percentage believed that the Italian currency would maintain its new rate against the mark, L'Espresso said.
The lira returned to the ERM on Monday four years after it crashed out of the grid under speculative pressure.

Its weakness following the 1992 exit helped Italian exporters and it returned at a stronger rate than the Italian government had wanted. The government had sought a central parity of 1,000 lire to the mark.
L'Espresso released the poll ahead of publication in the magazine on Friday.
